name: Capybara Zen
summary:
Capybara Zen is an indie narrative game that blends humor, adrenaline, chaos, mystery, and a touch of urban adventure, featuring immersive cutscenes, a complete story mode, and a frantic arcade mode.
You follow an ordinary capybara trapped in an empty, meaningless routine, until a visit to an old place turns its life upside down.
On the way to a job interview, the capybara observes abandoned streets, dirty alleys, closed stores... a city without color, without life, without anything. Along the way, it discovers that the old CapiGames, an arcade abandoned for years, has reopened downtown.
Upon entering and trying to turn on one of the arcade machines, the capybara is suddenly sucked into the game itself.
After a wild interdimensional journey, it awakens as Zen, a stylized, confident, and aggressive version of itself, trapped inside an unstable urban arcade world filled with obstacles, dangers, and unpredictable situations.
The game progresses with an arcade-paced rhythm, featuring constant challenges, money collection, and continuous progression. To free the capybara from this world, the player must reach increasingly higher stages while surviving an environment that grows progressively more chaotic. The story unfolds through cutscenes that can be replayed from the main menu after completing the story mode progression.
Capybara Zen is a frenetic experience that combines fast-paced action, storytelling, and an urban atmosphere. A game about persisting, moving forward, and trying to escape when everything feels out of control.
